# Hero Squad

> A static, framework-free website (HTML/CSS/vanilla JS) for a fictional superhero kids'-party service in Tajikistan. It has 6 pages in Russian, Tajik and English (18 HTML files generated by a Python script), 16 easter eggs, a missions/XP system, a guided tour, and a live multiplayer quest with an admin panel backed by Firebase Realtime Database (with a localStorage demo fallback). It was built as a web-design course project at KhPI TTU and is deployed on GitHub Pages.

Live site: https://komyor09.github.io/hero_squad/
Admin panel: https://komyor09.github.io/hero_squad/admin.html (demo password: avengers)

## Docs

## Source
- [tools/build_pages.py](tools/build_pages.py): generator for all 18 pages (edit text here, not in the HTML)
- [assets/js/data.js](assets/js/data.js): heroes, prices, `tr()` translation helper
- [assets/js/main.js](assets/js/main.js): UI, calculator, booking form
- [assets/js/secrets.js](assets/js/secrets.js): easter eggs and the J.A.R.V.I.S. terminal
- [assets/js/guide.js](assets/js/guide.js): missions, tour, QR modal
- [assets/js/live.js](assets/js/live.js): quest sync, leaderboard, bookings
- [assets/js/db.js](assets/js/db.js): database abstraction (Firebase or localStorage)
- [assets/js/admin.js](assets/js/admin.js): admin panel logic
- [database.rules.json](database.rules.json): Firebase security rules

## Tests
- [tests/e2e.py](tests/e2e.py): Playwright suites (smoke, all 18 missions, admin↔player quest)
